differences: Text A has one target: a single target creature gets +2/+0 and gains the death trigger. Text B uses two separate 'target creature' phrases, so the pump and the granted ability may hit different creatures.

Text B's granted ability says 'return this card to the battlefield tapped' and omits 'under its owner's control'. Text A states the owner's control explicitly; B leaves it to the default, so the wording differs even if the outcome is usually the same.
